page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head with page number at top; signature "D 2" at the foot; faint fragments of a neighbouring page at the left edge (show-through and edge, not transcribed).

main_text.p: singuli stolidi, & universi male foederati, mutua consilia non raro, mutuos actus eludunt: patent, tenentur: iam pridem iis dica scripta, & palam fraudis mendaciique convictis, fides abrogata. Sunt seductores alii, versipelles quidam Genii, ad fallacia & technas nati: Hi non in cute substituere, sicut Sensus; sed percolati, & medullam subeuntes, ad Animum penetraverunt: his utitur Animus; his, ut charissimis convictoribus, totum se credidit; his non ducitur jam; sed agitur, trahitur, raptatur: hos necessarios ei, hos ei dominos fecit diuturna familiaritas. Tandem tamen
main_text.notes: Catchword absent. The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Some words are set with hyphenation at line ends ("ma-", "elu-", "ta-"), and the line "Hi non in cute" reads as printed; the word "substitutere" appears printed as "substitêre" with a damaged letter, so it is marked as uncertain: substituere [?]. The line "mutuos actus" may read "mutuos astus" in the print; "actus" is given as the likelier reading [?].
